reconnaissance.worker/src/alerts.mjs: Three current subject-line shapes coexist: the legacy per-watch loop builds `CityScroll: ${fresh.length} new for "${w.label}"` (alerts.mjs:533); the single-active-watch account path (processOneSub) builds `CityScroll: ${parts} — ${label}` or a catch-up/quiet variant (alerts.mjs:1027-1041) and renders the body with the exported subDigestHtml() (alerts.mjs:2670); the multi-watch account rollup path (processAccountRollup, alerts.mjs:1133+) computes its subject via the exported rollupSubject() and its body via the exported rollupDigestHtml() (alerts.mjs:2922+), rendering one section per watch with quiet sections collapsed to one line. A row's rendered item kind ("Solicitation"/"Award"/etc, and which next-step CTA it gets) comes from its enclosing section's kind/lens, not from the row's own type_of_notice_description — confirmed by capture: an Award row placed in an "rfp"-kind section renders a solicitation-style CTA. Real award-arrival watches never produce this because worker/src/lib/compile.mjs:442-456 compiles them into their own kind:"award" query, and rollupDigestHtml has a dedicated isAwardWatchSection/awardCandidates branch (alerts.mjs:2985-2995) that a normal award watch always takes.
reconnaissance.worker/src/lib/rollup.mjs: Pure helpers only: isWatchActive, groupSubsByEmail, shouldRollup (rollup triggers once an email has >1 active watch), buildDigestJobs (fans SUBS rows into type:"sub" or type:"rollup" queue jobs), rollupSendDecision, rollupSubject (the exact `CityScroll: 1 new — 4 watches` multi-watch shape), rollupBodySections, rollupTocEntries, isQuietRollupSection, quietRollupSectionLine. No procurement-specific logic exists here yet; Card 1's procurement_alert_atom.mjs would be new.
reconnaissance.site/app/money-history.mjs: renderDetail() (money-history.mjs:1046) computes responseContextReady=solicitationResponseContextReady(r) and actionRailContextReady=(type!=="Solicitation")||responseContextReady, then sequences solicitationContextHeadingHTML(r) (line 1061) ahead of the #dactions rail (line 1062), gating buildApply(r,false) on responseContextReady (line 1065) and mountNoticeActionRail on actionRailContextReady (line 1100) — exactly as asserted by test/solicitation_response_context.test.mjs's structural test.
reconnaissance.site/app/money-list.mjs: The Respond-link affordance at money-list.mjs:1399 is gated by `matter.kind==="solicitation" && !solicitationResponseContextReady(r)` returning null.
reconnaissance.site/procurement_browse_query.mjs, site/: Browse query rows use a stricter numeric-only contract_amount than the raw per-object snapshot amount (see Fixture D's notes above) — procurement_browse_query.mjs is the bounded/filterable projection behind Contracts Browse; procurement_search_producer.mjs builds SearchDocument projections over the shared read model (and is what makes S48020 findable by "S48020"/"0000541781"); following_view.mjs is the watch/scope routing layer plus a slim followingPreviewItemHtml() digest-item preview distinct from the full email digItemHTML/subDigestHtml renderer (test/digest_preview_awareness.test.mjs asserts following_view.mjs does NOT define digItemHTML).
